description:
Whether you're riding a homemade ramp or visiting the skatepark for the first time, the Origin 540 offers the performance you need and an amazing price. The 540 offers a lightweight hollow box deck, one-piece welded steel handlebar, steel brake, 100 mm high impact wheels, and durable ABEC-7 bearings. Get ready to rip on the Origin 540!
Lightweight hollow box alloy deck with extended standing area.
Steel brake combine with 100 mm high impact alloy wheels and durable ABEC-7 bearings.
One-piece welded steel handlebar with rubber grips offer durability and comfort.
Double anodized clamp collar delivers precise steering.
Heavy-duty frame supports riders ages 8 and up, with a maximum weight of 220 lbs.
